name: Numeric
description: Manage close tasks, build financial reports, query your general ledger, and automate bulk operations — all through conversation. Combine Numeric with your favorite tools (like Slack, Gmail, Calendar, and more) to build custom agents and skills, and automate everyday accounting workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Numeric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Numeric to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.numeric.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Numeric MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Numeric lists 19 MCP tools, including list_workspaces, set_workspace, get_workspace_context, list_reports, get_report_data, build_report, get_report_row_trend, query_transaction_lines, list_financial_accounts, list_tasks, create_task, and edit_task.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Numeric?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Numeric in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Numeric requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Numeric is developed by Numeric. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
